results.name: FF-52 in the UI: an opened workbook shows Excel's results for empty text and an error constant (ISBLANK FALSE / TRUE, COUNTIF "#N/A" 1, COUNTA 3, "=" 1, "<>" 3, ISNA TRUE)
FF-52 typing: ' makes empty text (ISBLANK FALSE), #n/a makes an error constant (ISNA TRUE); Save → lxml lists A1 and C1 as empty text, openpyxl reads C2 as an error cell

shortcut scope: Paste Special is a non-modal bar (TT60) — the grid keeps the keyboard and ArrowRight still moves the target, but typing, Delete, Backspace, F2, Enter, Ctrl+X / V / Z / D / B never edit the cell behind it, nor do keys typed into the bar's own controls; Escape closes only the bar (Spreadsheet stays open)
